Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Bangladesh players are out there in the middle. Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock are the openers for South Africa. Shoriful Islam to start with the ball for Bangladesh. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, the target is not a big one for South Africa and they would have taken this target with both hands at the start of the game. Bangladesh, though, have a good variety in their bowling lineup and we can expect a good fight from them. Can they defend this total to script a historic series victory? Or will South Africa stay alive in the series with a win here? All the answers coming your way. Stay tuned for the chase.

Kagiso Rabada is down for a quick chat. Says it is a must-win game for them and he just tried to execute his skills. He accepts he was a bit ruthless this time around. Mentions, they bowled really well up front in the last game but could not pick up wickets. Adds that he is glad for his five-for but there is still a lot of work to do in the game. Adds, they would’ve been happier to chase less but that is what cricket is. He adds that he backs his batters to chase this down in a do-or-die situation.

All the euphoria of the first ODI win on the South African soil was put to rest early in the innings as wicket started tumbling one after another. In no time, they were five down and it was upto the experienced Mahmudullah and talented Afif Hossain to bring some stability into the innings. A 60-runs stand followed but Mahmudullah departed and then it was a brilliant partnership between Mehidy Hasan and Afif Hossain and the pair added 86 runs more to take their team over 150. However, once those two departed, it became a tough task for tail-enders to take them to a par score and they eventually failed to reach 200.

A strong bowling performance by South Africa! It would have been probably better if Parnell would have not got injured. The seamers were on fire with the new ball as they sent back half of the Bangladesh side back to the hut with just 34 runs on the board. However, the injury to Parnell made things little difficult for the skipper, Bavuma and he decided to bring himself on. Shamsi bowled well and took a wicket but Keshav Maharaj was a tad off-colour today. However, the pick of the bowlers was Rabada as he broke a dangerous partnership between Afif Hossain and Mehidy Hasan and ended with a five-wicket haul. Overall, a good performance by South African bowlers and their batters will fancy chasing this total down.

From 34-5, Bangladesh have managed to put 194 on the board. It shows the depth and confidence in this Bangladesh side but still a total that South Africa will be comfortable chasing on this pitch. South Africa, though will be tad disappointed especially after the start but they are still favourites to win this game, going into the second-half.
Swing and a miss to end the innings! Full length, outside off. Mustafizur Rahman tries to go downtown but only connects with thin air. Bangladesh end their innings at 194/9.
Fuller, outisde off. Ahmed plays it back to the bowler. Lungi Ngidi fumbles and the batters take a run.
Length ball, wide outside off. Taskin Ahmed tries to heave it away but misses.

DROPPED! Aiden Markram runs back and puts in a stupendous effort but he fails to grab it in the end. Touch short, outside off. Mustafizur Rahman throws his bat it. The ball flies towards third man. Aiden Markram puts everything into his attempt but only manages to get fingertips on it.
WIDE! Full length, wide outside off. Rahman leaves it alone. The ball though is outside the tramline and the umpire signals a wide.
Slower one, outside off. Rahman looks to heave it away but misses.
Fuller, outside off. Ahmed drives it to sweeper cover for one.

On leg, Ahmed tucks it to the leg side for one more. Rassie van der Dussen exceeded the expectations with his over here. Just 3 runs and a wicket off it. His maiden penultimate ODI over turns out to be extraordinary.
Angled into the pads, Rahman flicks it past mid on off his pads for one.
Fuller, on middle. Rahman eases it back to the bowler.
Length, outside off. Rahman punches it to point.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rassie van der Dussen picks up a wicket here. This is brilliant. Rassie van der Dussen pulls out a rabbit out of the hat here. Shortish, outside off. Shoriful Islam stands tall and pulls it to wide long on. The substitute fielder, Aiden Markram, takes a fine catch in the deep. Rassie van der Dussen picks up his first international wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Aiden Markram b Rassie van der Dussen

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads. Ahmed flicks it past mid on for a single.
Rassie van der Dussen is into the attack now.
Three runs off the over in the end! Low full toss, wide outside off. Ahemd slaps it to wide long off for another single. Can Bangladesh tail-enders take it above 200?
Full length, outside off. Islam drills it to long off for a single.
Very full, on middle. Islam clears his front leg and tries to hoick it across the line. The ball dies off the under-edge.
Full length, outside off. Islam shuffles across and tries to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, on off. Ahmed pushes it to extra cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Ahmed tries to heave it away but misses it completely.
Full outside off. Islam tries to heave it away but misses it completely.
Flicked to the leg side for another single.
Full, on middle, Islam tucks it to square leg for one.
Full, on off, Islam flicks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, on off. Taskin Ahmed whips it to short mid-wicket. Temba Bavuma tries ot gather it but gets pinged on his injured finger. They take one.
Fuller, on off. Ahmed defends it to mid on.
A length ball, on middle and elg. Shoriful Islam gets it to square leg off the inside edge. Kagiso Rabada pciks up two wickets in this over and gets his side back on top.
Shoriful Islam comes in to bat now.

OUT! Taken! Good catch by Janneman Malan! Bit of redemption for him and Rabada gets a five-wicket haul! This is fullish delivery on off. It holds on the surface a bit as Hasan checks his drive. The ball goes in the air towards mid off and Janneman Malan dives forward to take a good low catch. So both the set batters are gone now and a great chance to restrict Bangladesh under 200 now.
Commentary.Howout: c Janneman Malan b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: A fullish delivery on middle. Ahmed nudges it to square leg for a single.
Taskin Ahmed comes in at number 9.

OUT! TAKEN! Kagiso Rabada breaks the partnership and gets rid of dangerous Afif Hossain. Sigh of relief for South Africa and Afif Hossain walks back after playing a brilliant knock. Rabada bangs this one short on off. Afif Hossain goes for a pull shot but miscues it. The ball goes high in the air towards mid-wicket and Temba Bavuma there takes a fine catch. So can South Africa close this out quickly now?
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: A length delivery, on off. Afif Hossain defends it towards point.
On the shorter side on off. Afif Hossain sways away from the line of the ball and looks to upper cut it but misses.
Shorter and outside off. Hasan cuts it to point.
A flatter one on middle and leg. Afif Hossain works it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle. Hasan works it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle this time. Hasan sweeps it quite well and gets it to deep square leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Hasan drives it to covers.
SIX! Ohh...a biggie from Mehidy Hasan! A fuller delivery on off. Hasan gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.

FOUR! A length ball, on off. Afif Hossain heaves across the line, it flies towards third man off the outside edge. Boundary. The atmosphere is starting to feel like the for the visitors. The fans are roaring after every single run.
WIDE! A slower bumper, outside off. Hossain does not chase it. Wide called.
A short ball, outside off. Hasan was about to pull his blade back but ends up guiding it down to third man for one.
On a length, on off. Hossain punches it to point for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Hossain leans back and tries to play the ramp shot but misses it completely.
A length delivery on middle. Hasan works it to square leg for a single.
On the shorter side around off, slower delivery. Afif Hossain upper-cuts it towards third man for a single.
On middle and slower in the air. Afif Hossain works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off. Hasan drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Hasan chops it to point.
BYE! This is pushed down the leg side. Afif Hossain looks to reverse-hit it but misses. The ball hits Quinton de Kock's knee and the batters run a bye.
Flatter and slightly shorter on off. Afif Hossain works it to deep square leg and comes back for the second.
Fuller delivery on middle. Hasan knocks it down to long on for a single.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, around off. Afif Hossain looks to swing it across the line but misses.
Back of a length, on middle. Hasan works it past square leg for a single.
A slightly shorter length delivery, around off. Hasan lets it go as he sways away from the line of the ball.
A slower delivery on off. Afif Hossain looks to work it towards the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge of his blade onto the pads for a single.
A good-length delivery, around off. Hasan steers it towards third man for a single.
A shorter delivery, around off. Afif Hossain looks to pull but miscues it to mid on for a single.
Bavuma is going off the field! Another man down for South Africa. Now the concern will be, who will bowl the remaining overs? As Temba Bavuma was filling up for an injured Wayne Parnell himself.

DROPPED! A tough chance to be honest. This could be a huge blow for South Africa. It is full, on off. Hossain drives it aerially to the right of the bowler. Bavuma dives to that side, extends his right arm but only to get hit on the fingertips. It deflects to mid off. The batters cross for a single.
Full, outside off. Hasan pushes it to the off side for a single.
On the pads, Hossain tucks it to leg side for a single.

DROPPED! Oh dear! Quinton de Kock has his hand on his head after seeing Janneman Malan drop a catch in the deep. Full length, on off. Hasan flicks it aerially to deep mid-wicket. Malan covers a lot of ground to his right but misses the ball completely. It hits him on the chest before he even closes his hands.  They take one.
Touch short, on middle. Hossain gets inside and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full length, just outside off. Hossain shuffles across and defends it to cover.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
Short one, outside off. Afif Hossain cuts it to point for one.
Slower one yet again, overpitched outside off. Hossain pushes it to backward point with soft hands. Hence, it lands short of Keshav Maharaj placed there.
BEATEN! Pace on this time! Back of a length, outside off. Hossain tries to cut it away but fails to get any blade on it.
Back of a length, slower one, outside off. Hossain comes forward and taps it to point.
Good length, on top of off. Mehidy Hasan guides it towards third man for a single.
Fuller, on leg. Hasan tucks it to the leg side.
THE STAND MOVES TO 50! Some to cheer for the Bangladesh fans out there. Full length, outside off. Hasan pushes it to long off for a single.
On a length, outside off. Hasan tries to punch it to the off side but gets it off the inner half.
Outside off, pushes it to cover.
Full length, on middle and leg. Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
On the stumps, a bit too low. Hasan eases it back to the bowler.
Full, on off. Hasan defends it out on the front foot.
Length ball, on the pads. Hasan clips it to fine leg for another single.
A slower one, outside off. Hossain carves it through covers for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Hasan cuts it aerially to the right of third man. They take one as the ball lands safely.
Length ball, on the stumps. Hasan defends it to point from inside the crease.

LEG BYE! A length ball, angled into the pads. Hasan misses his flick, The ball rolls to mid-wicket off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Outside off. Hossain prods to defend it out solidly.
Full, on off. Hossain clips it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! What a shot! Tossed up, full and outside off. Afif Hossain strides forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Full, on leg. Hasan tucks it to the leg side for a single.

Tossed up, on off. Hossain shuffles across and tucks it to the leg side for a single. FIFTY FOR HOSSAIN. This has been a crucial knock for his side. The players in the pavilion rise and appreciate this effort.
Pulls his length back, around off. Hasan dabs it towards point.
A fullish delivery, around off. Afif Hossain drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Serves on a length, around off. Afif Hossain steers it towards backward point. The fielder there makes a good stop.
Lands on a length, around off. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
WIDE! This is fuller and way too wide outside off. Afif Hossain leaves it alone.
FOUR! Lovely shot! A fullish delivery on off. Afif Hossain drives it through covers and it is a bit uppish but in the gap. A boundary for Afif Hossain.
Goes fuller outside off. Afif Hossain drives it to covers. Bavuma there fumbles but no run taken.
Shorter and outside off. Afif Hossain cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. 13 runs from the over!
Slower in the air, on off. Afif Hossain defends it off the front foot.
Fuller now, on off. Hasan pushes it to long off for a single.
Quicker and flatter outside off. Hasan looks to cut but misses.
Full outside off. Hasan slashes it over point and gets a couple.
WIDE! This is pushed wider outside off. Hasan slashes at it hard but misses. It is given as wide and Free Hit continues.
NO BALL! Ohh another no ball from the spinner. This is outside off. Hasan skips down the track and looks to hit it away but gets the inside edge back to the keeper.
NO BALL AND SIX! This man can bat and South Africa need to be wary of him! This is on off. Hasan gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Free Hit coming up.
On off and fuller. Hasan defends it off the front foot.
Nicely bowled! Loopy delivery on off. Afif Hossain blocks it off the front foot.
Goes fuller on off. Afif Hossain defends it off the front foot towards the off side.
Beaten! Lands it on off and it turns away shaprly. Afif Hossain goes deep in his crease and looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Goes slower in the air, on off. Hasan pushes it to long on for a single.
Fuller on off. Hasan drives it to covers.
Slower in the air, on off. Afif Hossain drives it to long off for a single.
On middle and turning into the batter. Afif Hossain works it with turn towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes it quicker again on off. Afif Hossain defends it yet again.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Afif Hossain pushes it to short third man.
Pitches it outside off. Afif Hossain looks to sweep it but misses.

Drinks! Bangladesh have recovered slightly after losing five early wickets but South Africa are still in the driver's seat! They have managed to break the partnership between Mahmudullah and Afif Hossain and would be looking to wrap things quickly now. Bangladesh, on the other hand, need this pair to keep going as their is not much batting to follow. Can Afif Hossain and Mehidy Hasan revive Bangladesh innings? We shall find out in the next passage of play.
A flatter delivery and that is slightly shorter on middle. Hasan works it to short fine leg. Good tidy over again from Shamsi.
Slower in the air, on middle. Hasan gets forward and works it towards the leg side.
Tossed up on off. Afif Hossain drives it to long off for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Afif Hossain drives it to covers.
A flatter delivery, around off. Afif Hossain cuts it to point.
Beaten! It pitches on off and turns away. Afif Hossain looks to defend off the front foot but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Slower in the air, on middle. Hasan defends it towards the leg side. Just a run from the over.
Quicker and flatter on off. Hasan pushes it to covers.
On off and fuller. Afif Hossain pushes it to point for a single.
Tossed up nicely on off. Afif Hossain blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter and slightly shorter on off. Afif Hossain goes back and punches it towards mid-wicket.
Slower in the air, on off. Afif Hossain defends it off the front foot.
Fuller, on leg. Afif Hossain clips it to wide of mid on for a single.
On off, defended out solidly.
Short one, pitching on middle and leg. It turns away sharply off the deck. Afif Hossain cuts it to cover but could not find the gap.
Full, outside off. Hossain uses his feet and taps it to point.
Short, on middle and leg. Hasan glances it down to fine leg for a single.

The ball loops up  in front of Janneman Malan at first slip. Malan's first reaction was to go back but as he saw the ball lobbed in front of him, he tried to push himself forward and ends up slipping on the floor.
Tossed up, full, outside of. Hasan blocks it to cover.
Full, around off. Hasan defends it out watchfully.

Fuller, on off. Hossain pushes it back to the bowler. It was aerial and Keshav Maharaj misses out on this one.

Full, outside off. Mehidy Hasan drives it to cover.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hossain pushes it to mid on for a quick single.
Looped up, around off. Hossain taps it to point.
Fuller, on leg. Mehidy Hasan clips it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Mehidy Hasan off the mark in some fine fashion. It is a full toss, outside off. Mehidy Hasan prods and creams it through the cover region for a boundary.

Mahmudullah tries to flick it away to square leg but gets it finer. There is a leg slip in place only for these opportunities. Janneman Malan takes a sharp low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Janneman Malan b Tabraiz Shamsi

Flatter and outside off. Hossain goes back to cut it towards backward point.
Tossed up, on off. Hossain tucks it to the leg side.
Fuller, around off. Mahmudullah pushes it to mid off for a single.
Flatter, outside off. Afif Hossain hangs back and tries to cut it away but misses.
Fuller, on leg. Mahmudullah flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Floated, around off, this one flies off the deck. Mahmudullah blocks it out solidly.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hossain clips it to mid-wicket of a single.
On off, defended out solidly.

In the air...but safe! Slower in the air, on off. Mahmudullah skips down the track but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. He looks to go inside-out. It slices off the outside half of his blade over point for a couple.
Slower in the air, around off. Mahmudullah blocks it off the front foot.

A flatter delivery down the leg side. Mahmudullah looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards the keeper. He fails to pouch it.
Another loopy delivery on off. Afif Hossain drives it to short cover.
Lovely delivery! Around off and a good loop in this one. Afif Hossain defends it off the front foot towards the off side.
Fuller on middle. Mahmudullah works it towards deep square leg for a single.

Goes fuller on leg. Afif Hossain works it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! So good over for Bangladesh! Shorter delivery on off. Mahmudullah pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.

Lands on a length, on off. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
On midlde and flatter. Mahmudullah works it past square leg for a single.

Inside-edge saved Mahmudullah there! A flatter delivery on off. Mahmudullah looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads. There is a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down and South Africa don't opt for a review either.
Slightly shorter and flatter on middle. Afif Hossain goes deep in his crease and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Again slower, around off. Mahmudullah gets a thick outside edge this time as he looks to defend. The ball goes towards the third man region and a single is taken.
Slower in the air, on off. Mahmudullah gets well forward and blocks it.
Goes fuller on middle. Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket.
Drifting on the pads this time. Afif Hossain works it to short fine leg.
Goes slightly fuller on off. Afif Hossain leans forward and drives it to short cover.

Lands on a length again, around off. Afif Hossain blocks it out.
On a length, around off. Mahmudullah pushes it to covers for a single.
A leading edge! On a length, on middle. Mahmudullah looks to work it towards the leg side but is early on the shot. The ball catches the leading edge of his blade and goes towards the off side.
A dot end the over! Fuller, on off. Afif Hossain almost lobs it back to the bowler but it does not carry.
FOUR! Afif Hossain playing his natural game here. Looped up, full and on off. Afif Hossain gets low and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

Full, on off. Mahmudullah defends it out solidly.
On the stumps, blocked out.
Full, on off. Hossain drives it to mid off for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Hossain finds the sweeper cover with his drive. They take a single.

Fuller, on leg. Mahmudullah clips it through square leg for one.

Looped up, on off. Mahmudullah blocks it out watchfully.
A fuller delivery on off. Afif Hossain drives it to long off for a single.

Looped up, on off. Mahmudullah blocks it back to the bowler.
On off, defended out.
Fuller, outside off. Mahmudullah drives it to mid off off the front foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Goes full on off. Afif Hossain leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. 50 up for Bangladesh!
On the stumps. Hossain blocks it out solidly.
Lands on the length, on middle. Afif Hossain works it towards the leg side.
On a length, on middle. Afif Hossain defends it towards the off side.
On off, Hossain pushes it to cover.
Fuller, on off. Hossain works it to cover.
Temba Bavuma who bowled the last ball of Wayne Parnell's over, will continue.
Floated. full and outside off, Hossain defends it through covers for a single. A great start by Shamsi with the ball.
Fuller, on off. Hossain defends it into the deck off the front foot.
Tosses it up, full, on off. Hossain gets it to the off side off the outside edge.

Looped up, on middle and leg. Hossain clears his front leg and defends it to the leg side.

Wayne Parnell seems to be having some issue with his hamstring. The physio sprints into the field to have a look at it. He does some stretches but the physio is taking Wayne Parnell off the field. This will be some serious blow for South Africa. Temba Bavuma takes the ball now.

DRINKS! A much-needed one for Bangladesh. Their batters were just being attacked by the short ones mixed with a few that did not fly at all. South Africa clearly on top of the proceedings here. They have never allowed the batters to settle down at all. Bangladesh now need a gritty stand to make something out of the game. But it won't be easy against this South African pace attack.

Ohh..top-notch over from Parnell! A good-length delivery, around off and it goes across the batter. Mahmudullah looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Lands it on a length, around off. Afif Hossain guides it to third man for a single.
Afif Hossain comes in at number 7.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust and South Africa are responding after the loss in the first ODI, in some style! A good-length delivery that pitches on off and comes into Rahim a bit. He looks to defend but misses and gets rapped up on the pads. There is a big appeal from Parnell and the umpire raises his finger. Big wicket, this and Rahim knows he is a goner so doesn't take a review. Half of the side back to the hut now.
Beaten this time! On a good length and angling across Rahim. He looks to push at it but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
On a length, around off. Rahim defends it towards the off side.
Goes fuller on off. Rahim drives it to mid off.
Mahmudullah is the new batter in. Can the experienced duo of Rahim-Mahmudullah take the visitors to safer shores?

OUT! TAKEN! The extra bounce is just too hot to handle for these Bangladeshi batters! Rabada gets his third wicket now and Yasir Ali walks back early too. This on the shorter side on middle. Ali looks to defend but the ball is perfectly targeted on his body and it hurries him. The ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes in the air towards backward point. Keshav Maharaj takes an easy catch and Bangladesh are rocked early in this game.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Angling on the pads. A length delivery and Rahim works it to fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Rahim looks to work it towards the leg side. The ball goes off the outside edge of his blade towards point.
On the shorter side, outside off. Rahim lets it go. The ball keeps low again.
Goes slightly fuller now, around off. Rahim leans forward and pushes it towards covers.
Hits the length hard, outside off. Rahim leaves it alone.
Goes shorter around leg. Rahim pulls it right of the fielder leg fielder and takes a single as the fielder cuts it off.
Straighter line now, on middle. Rahim blocks it out solidly.
Lands it on a length, around off. Ali rides the bounce and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Ali defends it towards the off side.
A good-length delivery, outside off and it keeps low now. Ali looks to defend but the ball goes under his blade to the keeper.
Starts with a delivery that is on the shorter side on leg. Rahim works it towards fine leg for a single.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Wayne Parnell is into the attack now.
A length ball, on top of off. Yasir Ali stays back and defends it out solidly.
On a good length and seaming away, outside off. Ali dabs it towards point.
Back of a length, around off. Ali rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Length ball, on off, blocked out watchfully.
Length, on leg. Rahim clips it to the leg side for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Rahim.

NOT OUT & WIDE! This South African review goes Bangladesh's way, as they get one run off it. It is a short ball, wide outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim slashes at it but fails to get any blade on it. Kagiso Rabada and Quinton de Kock thinks they heard somethings. Temba Bavuma takes the review but the UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. Although, the replays later confirm that the ball is moving outside the tramline. Hence the umpire signals a wide.
Review! South Africa have taken a review for caught behind. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. So The original decision stays and Mushfiqur Rahim will continue.

Just a run off it! Lungi Ngidi ends this over with three dots on the trot. This is a length ball, outside off. One would expect the ball to continue to fly, but this one stays low and goes under the blade of Ali.
Length ball, on off. Ali gets behind the line and blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali covers his stumps and shoulders his arms at it.
LEG BYE! Lungi Ngidi fires in a full delivery, on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim misses his flick, it goes to fine leg off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Goes fuller around leg. Rahim looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the leg side.
On a good length, around off. Rahim defends it towards the off side off the front foot.
Length ball, on off. Rahim works it through point for a single.
Length ball, on off, Mushfiqur Rahim defends it to the off side.
WIDE! Another one wide outside off, Rahim does not chase it. Wide called.
WIDE! Fuller, wide outside the off stump. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone. Wide called.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Yasir Ali survives! A length ball, outside off. Yasir Ali tries to go hunting away from his body. It takes the outside edge and goes to the right of first slip. Keshav Maharaj reacts late and ends up putting it down. They take one.
Lands it on a length, around off. Ali senses some extra bounce and lets it go.
Good length, outside off, it flies off the deck. Ali leaves it alone.
Yasir Ali walks in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kagiso Rabada picks up his second wicket. The bounce continues to do the trick for South Africa. Bangladesh lose their third in no time. It is a short ball, on off, angling in off the deck. Liton Das tries to sway away from the line of the delivery but fails to drop his hands. The ball goes towards Quinton de Kock off the gloves, who takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on the pads. Das flicks it to deep square leg for one. 8 runs come off the over. Bangladesh need more overs like this.
FOUR! This is glorious. Back of a length, on off. Das stays on the back foot, pulls it over mid-wicket to bag a much-needed boundary.

WOAH! Just over! Bangladesh batters walking on a thin rope here. It is short, wide outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim should've left it alone, but goes chasing. The ball goes off the toe-end and just evades the cover fielder. They take three before the fielder cuts it out.

BEATEN! This is a super delivery. Bit of movement along with the bounce. Good length, outside off, it nips away off the deck, with some extra bounce. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to defend it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, on off, it nips in a bit. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to flick it to the leg side but is a tad early into his shot. The ball takes the leading edge but luckily lands in front of the batsman.
Good length, on off. Rahim pushes it to the off side.
Back of a length, on off. Das leans back and tries to ramp it above the keeper's head but misses to get any blade on it.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. The bounce is really getting the better of the Bangladesh batters here. Mushfiqur Rahim clips it awkwardly to the left of the keeper. They take one.
Full length, on off, with some extra bounce off the deck. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to cover but unable to squeeze it through the gap.
Back of a length, on top of off. Mushfiqur Rahim defends it to point.
Goes short and wide outside off. Rahim cuts it left of point and the ball races away towards the third man region. Ngidi moves to his right and stops it. Two runs taken.
A good-length delivery, around off. Rahim leaves it alone watchfully as the ball nips back into him.
FOUR! Ohh...in the air but a bit too wide of the fielder at covers! Good shot! Short and wide outside off. Das cuts it left of the cover fielder uppishly and the ball races away towards the fence.
On a good length, outside off. Das leaves it alone.
Lands it on a length, around off. Das opens the face of his blade and guides it left of backward point. Keshav Maharaj dives to his left and stops it.
Beauty! Pitches it on a length and caughts Das in his crease as he looks to defend. The ball seams away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Good leave! A good-length delivery, outside off. Das leaves it alone watchfully.
There is that extra bounce again. Lands it on a length and Das defends it from his crease, the ball hits him high on his blade.
So just a run and a wicket for South Africa from this over. On a length, on middle and leg. Rahim defends it towards the leg side.
Another delivery on that tight line.  Rabada lands this on middle and on a length. Rahim plays it by going deep in his crease.
Lands it on a length, on off. Rahim goes back and blocks it solidly.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two big wickets are down now and Kagiso Rabada gets the big fish, Shakib Al Hasan! This pitches on a length again, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan looks to work it towards the leg side. He is early on the shot and gets the leading edge of his blade. The ball goes towards covers and Kyle Verreynne moves behind swiftly to take a fine catch. Again the bounce does the trick for South Africa and Bangladesh are in early trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Verreynne b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches this on a length, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
On a good length, around off. Das pushes forward to defend. The ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes towards deep backward point for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out solidly towards the off side. End of a successful over from Lungi Ngidi.
Lands this on a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it off the front foot.
Back of a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan dabs it towards point.
Wow! That is some bounce. A length ball, outside off, shaping across the left hander. It flies off the deck. Shakib Al Hasan shuffles across and leaves it alone in the end.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Lungi Ngidi strikes and the extra bounce does the trick for South Africa! Ngidi lands this on a length, around off. Iqbal pushes forward to defend and the ball bounce a touch more than he expected. The ball hits the shoulder of his blade and loops in the air towards backward point. Keshav Maharaj runs forward and takes an easy catch. Lungi Ngidi has started well and Bangladesh lose an early wicket and a big one of their skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Iqbal defends this off the front foot the ball hits him high on the bat.
On a length, on middle. Das defends it towards the leg side. Good start by Rabada.
FOUR! This time drifting on the pads and Das takes full advantage of it. On middle and fuller. Das flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Goes fuller outside off. Das looks to drive it away from his body but misses again.
Three in a row now! On a good length, outside off. Das looks to steer it towards third man but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Beaten again! Back of a length, around off and Das looks to push at it again. The ball seams away again and beats him.
Bit of pace and bounce straightaway! A good-length delivery, outside off and it seams away with good bounce to beat the outside edge of Liton Das blade as he looks to push at it.
It is Kagiso Rabada who gets to operate with the second new ball.

In the air, for some time again but safe! On a length on middle. Iqbal looks to clip it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball loops in the air but falls well short of square leg.
Goes slightly short again, around off. Das rides the bounce and steers it towards third man for a single. Not much movement with new ball so far for Ngidi.
Back of a length, around off. Das dabs it towards the off side.
Slightly shorter on off. Das is right behind it and defends it onto the turf.
Serves this on a length, on off. Das blocks it out.

A length delivery on middle. Iqbal works it uppishly and just short of Kyle Verreynne at square leg. He fires a off-target throw towards Quinton de Kock behind the stumps and the batters take a run off an overthrow. Iqbal is off the mark.
WIDE! Lungi Ngidi starts with a wayward delivery! It lands on a length and is down the leg side. Iqbal looks to clip it but misses. Bangladesh get their first run on the board from a wide.

Done with all the pre-match proceedings! The South African players are seen to be in a huddle before they take the field. Followed by Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das who walk out to bat for Bangladesh. All the players take the knee to show their support to the 'BLM' movement ,before we get going. Lungi Ngidi to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Well then, the South African players stride out to the middle sporting a pink jersey for this special occasion. Followed by the visiting side in their typical green one. Both the teams will get lined-up in the middle for their respective National Anthem. It will be Bangladesh's first followed by the hosts anthem.

Shaun Pollock is near the deck. He says it is a nice surface. It does not look as pretty as a Test surface. There is some moisture on the surface, but the roller operating at the halfway mark will only make the pitch flatter.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that they were not sure about what they wanted to do. He adds that they would like to bowl well now. He mentions that there is some green tinge and the new ball will be key and their are few cracks. He informs that their are some changes. Tells that they need to do well in all disciplines and picking early wickets is focus. Talking about short boundaries, he says that they need be aware of their plans and execute them better.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, is in for a chat. He says they will bat first. Says, the history of the ground has been such that the side batting first has managed to put a humongous total on the board. Mentions, it is the best position for their side. No players need any more motivation and says, the players just need to focus on applying themselves in the middle. Informs us that there are no changes to the side.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock (WK) (In place of Aiden Markram), Temba Bavuma (C), Kyle Verreynne, Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Wayne Parnell (In place of Andile Phehlukwayo), Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi (In place of Marco Jansen).

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Bangladesh. They have elected to BAT first.

The hosts have a lot to improve given their bowling wasn't upto the mark. In home conditions, the pacers were quite average with Lungi Ngidi receiving a thumping. The abysmal performance continued with the bat as the top order faltered. Only some counterattack from Rassie van der Dussen and a blitz from David Miller saw them reach above 250 but they need to pull up their socks and get back in the series today. Can the visitors inflict more misery on the hosts and clinch a monumental away series win? Or will the hosts show what they are made of? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

The win in the first match of the series was set up by the Bangladeshi top order with 3 of the top five getting a 50 plus score and skipper Tamim Iqbal getting to 41 as well. With plenty runs on the board, Taskin Ahmed and Shoriful Islam ripped through the South African top order in the first Powerplay. It was then Mehidy Hasan who spun a web in the latter half to notch a memorable victory for the visitors. They will be all pumped up for this clash.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd ODI between South Africa and Bangladesh at Johannesburg. It's a pink day at the Wanderers and South Africa will hope that it will bring change in fortunes for them. The 2nd match of a three-match series is always the most important one and it will be interesting to see as to which side can hold their nerves and get the win. For the hosts, it is a do-or-die game, whereas the Bangla Tigers will be looking to churn out another team performance to seal the series.
... MATCH DAY …
